Husband of Murder Accused Found Dead on Railway Tracks

The husband of Urmila Saini, who was a fugitive in her murder case, has been found dead on railway tracks. He had been absconding for eight days. His body was discovered near the railway line, marking a significant development in the ongoing investigation.
